description: Registers a local stdio MCP server proxying notion-search/notion-fetch to Notion's hosted MCP server, refreshing the signed-in person's OAuth token as needed.

outputs.description: No asset -- registers a Dagster resource (a stdio MCP server) for other components to reference via server_resource_key.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key other components reference via server_resource_key.

oauth_dir.label: Oauth Dir
oauth_dir.description: Directory holding tokens.json + client_info.json from the sign-in CLI. Treat as a secret.

max_requests_per_second.label: Max Requests Per Second
max_requests_per_second.description: Shared by every tool call this server process makes -- see NotionMcpRateLimiter.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retries on Notion's own text-based rate-limit signal or a transient error before returning {'error': ...} to the agent.
